resources.string: A lightweight Chinese–English model with only 0.6B parameters (int4 quantized). Runs entirely on this device: no network, no API quota. Long sentences are translated less accurately than by a cloud model.

Tencent\'s Hunyuan translation-specialised model (1.8B, int8 quantized, 33 languages). Clearly better translations than the 0.6B one, and it also runs entirely on this device. The trade-offs are a much larger download, a much higher memory requirement, and a few seconds of loading on first use.
